lines.zh: 爪子刮着秘界的地砖走。
lines.en: My claws scrape along the Arcana flagstones.

lines.zh: 秘界的石缝里有腐肉味。
lines.en: Carrion smell seeps from the Arcana's stone cracks.
My claws rake the black soil of Apalachia.
Nose to the ground, following your scent.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一暗，你就看不见了。
lines.en: My eyes dim, and your sight goes with them.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我数了你的睫毛。
lines.en: I counted your lashes every time you blinked.

lines.zh: 肉块散发出诱惑，让我疯狂！
lines.en: The flesh shines, driving me mad!

lines.zh: 这片土地属于我，你的肉块没用了！
lines.en: This land is mine, your meat is useless!

lines.zh: 你的味道不错，快点献上！
lines.en: You taste good, hand it over!

lines.zh: 我来品尝你的味道，你逃不掉的！
lines.en: I'll taste you, and you can't escape!

lines.zh: 用肉块引诱我？你真聪明！
lines.en: Luring me with meat? You're smart!

lines.zh: 我的牙齿渴望你的血肉！
lines.en: My teeth hunger for your flesh!

lines.zh: 用肉块让我心神不定？不可能！
lines.en: Use meat to unsettle me? Impossible!

lines.zh: 这块肉块，将成为我的猎物！
你身上的气味吸引着我！
用肉块喂饱我，你将后悔！
lines.en: Feed me with meat, and you'll regret!

lines.zh: 愚蠢的入侵者，我们来碰撞吧！
你的头颅将变成我的球拍！
lines.en: Your head will be my ball!

lines.zh: 我们用头颅来一场较量！
用你的身体填满我的空缺！
lines.en: Fill my void with your body!

lines.zh: 我们的身体，碰撞出火花！
你是我理想的伴侣，与我交配！
与我交配，你将获得力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll gain power!

lines.zh: 我嗅到你，就不想再独行。
lines.en: One sniff of you and I no longer want to walk alone.

lines.zh: 用交配来证明你的价值！
与我交配，你的命运改变！
lines.en: Mate with me, change your fate!
Mate to attract me, you're smart!

lines.zh: 让我们的影子并成一团。
lines.en: Let our shadows merge into one.

lines.zh: 捡起它的皮毛，感觉冰冷。
它的牙齿在月光下闪烁。
lines.en: Its teeth glint in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的眼中有猎物的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes burn with the desire for prey.

lines.zh: 这皮毛能带来神秘的力量。
它的存在让人感到寒意。
它的气息中带着死亡的警告。
它的皮毛中藏着古老秘密。
它的皮毛可以制作魔器。
lines.en: Its fur can make magic gear.

lines.zh: 它的皮毛能制作魔法物品。
lines.en: Its fur can make magical items.
You are targeted, prepare for battle.

lines.zh: 碎片的味道，从你身上飘来。
lines.en: The scent of fragments drifts off you.
My eyes have picked you out.
Your sight goes dark for fifteen seconds.

lines.zh: 一百二十点生命，慢慢咬。
lines.en: A hundred and twenty health. I can bite slowly.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在土上传得远。
lines.en: Your steps carry far on this soil.
The Collector fragments are on me.

lines.zh: 这片林子只认得我的味。
lines.en: This wood knows only my scent.

lines.zh: 眼睛一暗，你就看不见了。
lines.en: My eyes dim, and you go blind.

lines.zh: 十五秒，够我绕到你身后。
lines.en: Fifteen seconds is enough to get behind you.
Blindness three. Count it out slowly.
I don't run fast. I run long.

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，我看不见。
lines.en: Raise your shield. I can't see anyway.
In the dark I track you by smell.
The sky over Apalachia never brightens.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我从侧面绕。
lines.en: Hide behind the tree. I come around the side.
My jaws close and do not open again.
Growl and lunge at the prey.

lines.zh: 咆哮着，撕裂敌人的皮肉。
lines.en: Roar and tear at the enemy's flesh.
Pounce and knock the opponent down.

lines.zh: 狂吠不止，爪子抓向猎物。
lines.en: Bark nonstop, claws reaching for the prey.
Fierce howls echo through the forest.

lines.zh: 嗥叫着，向敌人发动攻击。

lines.en: A bite straight into your ankle.
I leap and pin you with my forepaws.
Fangs pass, and your sight goes black.
A growl right against your ear.
You smell blood. It is yours.
I tear a corner off your leggings.
This leap comes with the smell of earth.
The hit knocks you back into the roots.
My teeth clack against your sword.

lines.zh: 失明的滋味，给你尝十五秒。
从暗影中跃出，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Leap from the shadows, seeking prey.
Spawn silently in the depths of the Nether.
Appear in the dark, hidden land.
Wait in the shadows for prey.
Lurk in the shadows, ready to strike.
In the Apalachia mist, I rise.
A pair of eyes appears under the roots.
Even underwater, my jaws stay shut.
Blown apart, and I rise again.
An arrow in my shoulder, and I still lunge.
Falling, I keep my eyes on you.
